description: Renovate maintains the release-tools/ npm lockfile and the GitHub Actions pins, replacing the Dependabot version updates this repository used, as in the other hegemony-sh repositories. Every `uses:` is pinned to a commit SHA, and without something bumping them they rot silently. The release-tools group and the conventional-changelog exception carry over from the former .github/dependabot.yml. Third-party releases wait a week before they are proposed (minimumReleaseAge); security fixes do not. Its commits are chore(deps), which commitlint accepts as they are.

packageRules.description: release-tools/ is one semantic-release toolchain; its updates move together in one pull request, majors included, as the former Dependabot group did. separateMajorMinor is off here because Renovate would otherwise put major updates on a branch of their own.

Preset 10 needs conventional-changelog-writer 9, and the latest @semantic-release/release-notes-generator (14.1.1) still loads writer 8, so release notes fail to render. Drop this once a stable notes generator moves to writer 9; CI's release dry run proves the pair.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A known vulnerability is not weekly business: these bypass the schedule and are labelled so they stand out.
